spans.s:
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Wet, damp; also ओण.
m. (-लः)
An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum.)
E.
वल or वल्ल to destroy, (complaints, especially hoemorrhoids.) अच् affix, व changed to ओ.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (इ) ओलडि (ओलण्डति or ओलण्डयति.)
To dart or throw up:
some consider the initial vowel to be indicatory, and make the root लडि q. v.
